Summary: Coordinator logs in and sees only permitted pages
Description: As a coordinator, I want to log in and see only the pages allowed for my role so that student and tutor records stay protected. Acceptance criteria: valid credentials create a session; the administrator reaches coordinator pages; a tutor is blocked from admin routes with status 403.

Summary: Coordinator creates, searches and updates student records
Description: As a coordinator, I want to create, search and update student records so that the centre works from one current list. Acceptance criteria: name, year level and family contact are required; valid records persist and appear in the list; invalid input is refused.

Summary: Coordinator creates and updates tutor records
Description: As a coordinator, I want to create and update tutor records so that I can match tutors to the subjects they teach. Acceptance criteria: name and subjects are required; status changes preserve linked sessions; deactivated tutors cannot be booked.

Summary: Coordinator records weekly tutor availability
Description: As a coordinator, I want to record weekly tutor availability so that bookings follow the hours tutors actually work. Acceptance criteria: day, start and end are stored; the end must be later than the start; a tutor may hold several windows.

Summary: Coordinator books a session inside availability
Description: As a coordinator, I want to book a session inside a tutor's availability so that the timetable stays valid. Acceptance criteria: 60 and 90 minute sessions are supported; the full session fits one matching window; out-of-window bookings are refused with a clear reason.

Summary: Coordinator moves, cancels and records outcomes
Description: As a coordinator, I want to move, cancel and mark sessions so that the record reflects what happened. Acceptance criteria: a move rechecks availability; cancelled sessions stay visible; attended and missed outcomes are recorded; finished sessions cannot be edited.

Summary: Coordinator views the schedule and student history
Description: As a coordinator, I want a day and week schedule plus student history so that I can answer questions at the desk. Acceptance criteria: day and week views show the correct sessions; student history lists past and future bookings.

Summary: Tutor views their own upcoming sessions
Description: As a tutor, I want to see my own upcoming sessions so that I know my week. Acceptance criteria: only the logged-in tutor's future booked sessions appear; an empty list is shown rather than an error.

Summary: Coordinator searches students by family contact name
Description: As a coordinator, I want to search students by family contact name so that I can find a record when a parent calls. Acceptance criteria: contact-name search returns the matching student; the status filter still applies.

Summary: Coordinator searches tutors by subject
Description: As a coordinator, I want to search tutors by subject so that I can fill a session quickly. Acceptance criteria: subject search returns matching tutors; a nonsense term returns no matches.

Summary: System bounds student and tutor field lengths
Description: As a coordinator, I want field lengths to be bounded so that bad input cannot break a record or a page. Acceptance criteria: over-limit fields return status 400 with a clear message; boundary values are accepted.

Summary: Coordinator edits an availability window
Description: As a coordinator, I want to edit an availability window so that small timetable changes do not need a delete and re-entry. Acceptance criteria: the edit page is prefilled; a valid edit is saved and redirects with status 303.

Summary: System rejects duplicate availability windows
Description: As a coordinator, I want duplicate availability windows rejected so that each hour appears once. Acceptance criteria: a duplicate returns status 400 and creates no second row.

Summary: Team delivers Docker and continuous integration
Description: As a team, we want Docker and continuous integration so that the release can be rebuilt and checked. Acceptance criteria: the image builds; CI runs the test suite on push and pull request.

Summary: Coordinator filters and prints a tutor schedule
Description: As a coordinator, I want to filter and print a tutor schedule so that I can pin the week on the staff board. Acceptance criteria: the tutor filter survives day and week views; print CSS hides navigation and controls.

Summary: Term unavailability for tutors
Description: As a coordinator, I want to mark a tutor away for specific dates so that the timetable matches leave and placements. Acceptance criteria: unavailable dates block new bookings; existing bookings are flagged for review.

Summary: Overlap detection for tutor and student
Description: As a coordinator, I want overlapping bookings refused so that one tutor or student is never double booked. Acceptance criteria: an overlapping request returns a clear error and creates no session.

Summary: Room allocation and clash detection
Description: As a coordinator, I want to assign rooms and refuse room clashes so that two sessions never share a space. Acceptance criteria: a room can be attached to a session; a clash returns a clear error.

Summary: Invoices and prepaid packs
Description: As a centre owner, I want invoices and prepaid packs so that billing follows the sessions delivered. Acceptance criteria: a monthly total can be produced from attended sessions.

Summary: SMS reminders
Description: As a coordinator, I want a night-before SMS reminder so that families are less likely to miss a session. Acceptance criteria: a reminder is queued for each booked session and failures are logged.

Summary: Audit trail
Description: As a coordinator, I want an audit trail so that changes to sessions can be traced. Acceptance criteria: moves, cancellations and outcome changes record the user and time.

Summary: Parent portal and self-service booking
Description: As a parent, I want to book and review sessions myself so that I do not need to phone the centre. Acceptance criteria: a parent sees only their family records and booking rules still apply.

Summary: Blue card expiry tracking
Description: As a coordinator, I want blue card expiry dates tracked so that only cleared tutors are booked. Acceptance criteria: an expired card blocks new bookings and appears on a review list.
